title: Private Sommelier-led Sonoma or Napa Wine Country Tour in VW Van
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Wineries are not guaranteed to be wheelchair accessible and our vans do not have ramps or special loading capabilities.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This Northern California wine tour, led by a Sommelier guide, offers a personalized experience with small groups (up to 6) in an electric Volkswagen ID Buzz Van. Guests enjoy curated visits to unique, family-owned wineries, tasting exceptional small-production wines. The tour includes pick-up/drop-off from your accommodation, a flexible itinerary, and insights from a wine expert, creating a memorable and educational journey.
